# igrep

igrep is an interactive search tool that runs a fast search engine in the background and allows you to pick results interactively and open the selected match in your text editor.

Supported platforms: macOS, Linux (Windows reportedly supported).

Usage
-----
ig [OPTIONS] <PATTERN|--type-list> [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  <PATTERN>    Regular expression used for searching.
  <PATHS>...   Files or directories to search. Directories are searched recursively.
               If not specified, searching starts from current directory.

Options (high level):
  --hidden                    Search hidden files and directories.
  --editor <EDITOR>           Text editor used to open selected match.
  --context-viewer <VIEWER>   Context viewer position at startup [default: none]
  --custom-command <COMMAND>  Custom command used to open selected match. Must contain {file_name} and {line_number} tokens.
  -g, --glob <GLOB>           Include files/directories matching the given glob.
  -h, --help                  Print help information
  -i, --ignore-case           Searches case insensitively.
  -L, --follow                Follow symbolic links while traversing directories
  -S, --smart-case            Smart case sensitivity behavior
  -t, --type <TYPE>           Only search files matching TYPE
  -T, --type-not <TYPE>       Do not search files matching TYPE
  --theme <THEME>             UI color theme [default: dark]
  --type-list                 Show all supported file types and their corresponding globs.
  -V, --version               Print version information.
  -w, --word-regexp           Only show matches surrounded by word boundaries
  -F, --fixed-strings         Exact matches with no regex

Keybindings
-----------
q, Esc, Ctrl+c      Quit
? / F1              Open/close the keymap popup
Down / j            Select next match
Up / k              Select previous match
Right / l           Select match in next file
Left / h            Select match in previous file
gg / Home           Jump to the first match
Shift-g / End       Jump to the last match
Enter               Open current file
dd / Delete         Filter out selected match
dw                  Filter out all matches in current file
v                   Toggle vertical context viewer
s                   Toggle horizontal context viewer
+ / -               Increase/decrease context viewer size
F5 / /              Open search pattern popup
n / m / c / a       Sorting and navigation shortcuts

Specifying text editor
----------------------
Order of precedence when selecting editor:
  1. --editor option
  2. $IGREP_EDITOR environment variable
  3. $VISUAL environment variable
  4. $EDITOR environment variable

Custom command example:
  --custom-command "vim +{line_number} {file_name}"
  or set via environment: IGREP_CUSTOM_EDITOR="vim +{line_number} {file_name}"

Installation
------------
Prebuilt binaries are available from the project releases.
Package managers:
  - Homebrew: `brew install igrep`
  - Scoop: `scoop install igrep`
  - Pacman (Arch): `pacman -S igrep`
  - Alpine: `apk add igrep`

License
-------
See the LICENSE file in this repository for license information.
